values.value: Reconcile MDQ segment pricing on Quote {quoteId}

1. Open Quote {quoteId} and inspect MDQ segments for {productName} ({segmentCount} segments, {flaggedSegs} flagged). 2. Either re-apply a consistent escalator schedule across segments, or capture an approval for the differentiated pricing. 3. If imported with drift baked in: correct each affected segment line by line. 4. Inspect the price-escalator schedule (SBQQ__BlockPrice__c or custom) — was it active when this quote was generated? 5. Add a validation on MDQ-segmented quotes that flags inconsistent per-product pricing pre-activation.
Segment pricing reconciled with escalator schedule applied.
Approval captured for differentiated per-segment pricing.
MDQ drift acceptable per customer-signed amendment; suppressing.
